title: Risky Lion Surgery | Bondi Vet Season 3 Episode 15 | Bondi Vet Full Episodes
description:
In a one hour South African special, Bondi Vet Dr Chris Brown is travelling far beyond his comfort zone to realise a lifelong ambition. In an extraordinary adventure,  he will meet the ultimate lion whisperer Kevin Richardson and perform surgeries on two big cats. Dr Chris also joins in the battle to protect the endangered black rhino from poachers and makes friends with a hand reared cheetah and baby rhino. Throw in a mobile vet clinic to one of the poorest areas of Johannesburg and a school visit which results in some delightful impromptu dance classes for an Aussie vet who is finding the true spirit of South Africa.
